app.name: Foxfleet
hub.title: Connect to your hub
hub.body: Your hub is the server that talks to your agents. Enter its address, or open a connect link from the hub.
hub.allowHttpHint: Only for a hub on your home or office network, or for development. Public hubs must use https.
hub.unreachable: Can't reach a Foxfleet hub at that address.
hub.notHub: That address answered, but it isn't a Foxfleet hub.
hub.scanHint: On a phone, use the Foxfleet app to scan the pairing QR.
auth.setupCodeHint: Printed in the hub's log on first start
auth.signin.title: Sign in
auth.setup.title: Create your account
auth.setup.body: This hub has no owner yet. You'll be the owner.
auth.join.title: Join this hub
auth.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
home.title: Agents
error.network: Can't reach the hub. Check your connection.
home.pick: Pick an agent to start chatting.
chat.showUnavailable: Show commands that can't run from here
chat.fileTooBig: Files can be up to {mb} MB.
chat.tooBig: This message is too large to send. Remove an image.
chat.drop: Drop images or files to attach
manage.title: Manage agents
manage.confirmRemove: Remove {name}? Its saved keys are deleted from the hub.
manage.saved: Saved on the hub · leave blank to keep
manage.name: ID
screen.title: {agent}'s screen
screen.controlling: You are in control · hands back in {time}
screen.unsupported: This agent has no screen available.
screen.takeoverFailed: Could not take over right now.
screen.handbackFailed: Could not hand back; control ends automatically.
screen.typeHere: Type to send keys to the remote screen
admin.title: Admin
admin.pairHint: Open the Foxfleet app, choose Scan QR on the first screen, and point it here.
account.title: Devices & security
account.signOutAllHint: Every device, including this one, will need to sign in again.
account.changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
settings.title: Settings
pwa.update: A new version of Foxfleet is ready.
manage.bootstrapBody: This is shown once. It contains a secret token. If it leaks, get a new token and the old one stops working.
machines.title: Machines
machines.intro: A machine is a computer running the Foxfleet connector. One connector shares all of its Hermes profiles; nothing on it needs an open port.
machines.empty: No machines yet. Connect one and its Hermes profiles show up as agents.
machines.confirmRevoke: Revoke {name}? It disconnects and its agents are removed.
machines.step1: Open a terminal on the computer that runs Hermes (macOS, Linux or WSL) and paste:
machines.needs: Needs Node.js 22 or newer. Nothing else is installed.
machines.qr: Scan to open this link on the machine's browser
machines.promptText: Run this command on this computer and answer its questions: {cmd}
machines.trouble: Having trouble? See the troubleshooting guide in the docs.
chat.historyFailed: Couldn't load or refresh history. Existing conversations are kept below.
chat.q.awaiting_stop: Waiting for the reply to stop
chat.noSteer: This agent cannot be steered while it works
chat.q.uncertain: Not sure it arrived. Checking with Hermes…
chat.q.rejected: Hermes did not accept it. Your text is kept below.
chat.q.cantCancel: Hermes holds this message; it cannot be taken back from here
req.noQuestion: The agent asked something without a question text. You can send an empty answer to let it continue.
ctl.modelNeedsChat: Send the first message first: the model is set per conversation.
ctl.noModels: This agent did not list any models.
ctl.busyTitle: Hermes default for messages sent while it works
ctl.busyWarn: This is a setting of the Hermes profile. Changing it affects every chat of this profile, including the terminal and messaging apps. The Send mode of this app (next to the send button) only changes what this app asks for.
ctl.busyConfirm: Change it for the whole Hermes profile?
ctl.busyFailed: Could not read or change it: {error}
picker.model.title: Choose a model
picker.modelSet: Model for this chat is now {model}. Your Hermes default is unchanged.
chat.busyCmd: Send behaviour while Hermes works is a profile setting: open Agents ▸ your Hermes agent. Type /steer, /queue or /stop for a single message.
picker.noGlobal: Changing the Hermes default is not done from the chat. Use the agent settings.
chat.agentUnavailableHint: The agent in this link is not in your fleet. Choose another agent from navigation.
chat.run.disconnected: Connection interrupted; task may still be running
chat.runFailed: The agent reported that this task failed.
chat.runUnavailable: This reply stream is no longer available. Check the conversation to confirm what happened.
chat.retryHint: The hub rejected this request. Retry sends it again.
chat.reloadHint: Reload the available messages for this conversation.
chat.reconnectHint: Check existing work before sending again. Reconnecting does not send a second task.
